applyTo.name: A switch changes
applyTo.hint: Which tokens of a character change: in every Vista, or only in the Vista where the switch was made. Unlinked tokens always change alone.

newTokens.name: New tokens keep the portrait
newTokens.hint: A character placed in a Vista starts with the portrait chosen last instead of the actor image.
